A holder can request Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.

A holder can request Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A holder can request An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
